title.am: HATI ዋና የመሠረተ ልማት ውል አሸነፈ
title.om: HATI Kontiraakta Ijaarsa Bu'uuraa Guddatu Argatte

excerpt.en: HATI Construction has secured a major contract for the East African Highway Project, marking a significant milestone in regional infrastructure development.
excerpt.am: HATI ግንባታ ለምስራቅ አፍሪካ አውራ ጎዳና ፕሮጀክት ዋና ውል አግኝቷል፣ ይህም በክልል መሠረተ ልማት ልማት ውስጥ ጉልህ ምዕራፍ ነው።
excerpt.om: HATI Ijaarsa dhaabbanni porjeektii daandii Bahaa Afriikaaf kontiraakta guddaa argate, kun immoo guddina bu'uuraa naannoo keessatti sadarkaa guddaa agarsiisa.

title.en: New Innovation Center Opens in Nairobi
title.om: Iddoo Uumama Haaraa Nayiroobii Keessatti Baname

excerpt.en: HATI announces the opening of its state-of-the-art innovation center in Nairobi, dedicated to advancing construction technology and sustainable practices.
excerpt.am: HATI በናይሮቢ ዘመናዊ የፈጠራ ማዕከል መከፈቱን አስታወቀ፣ ይህም የግንባታ ቴክኖሎጂን እና ዘላቂ ተግባራትን ለማሳደግ የተዘጋጀ ነው።
excerpt.om: HATI iddoo uumama haaraa teeknoolojii olaanaa qabu Nayiroobii keessatti banuu isaanii beeksise, kan teknolojii ijaarsaa fi hojii dhaabaa fooyyessuuf qophaa'e.

excerpt.en: HATI commits to sustainable construction practices across all projects, implementing green building standards and reducing environmental impact.
excerpt.am: HATI በሁሉም ፕሮጀክቶች ላይ ዘላቂ የግንባታ ልምዶችን ለመተግበር፣ አረንጓዴ የግንባታ ደረጃዎችን በማስፈን እና የአካባቢ ተጽኖን ለመቀነስ ቃል ገብቷል።
excerpt.om: HATI sadarkaa ijaarsa magaalaa fi dhiibbaa naannoo hir'isuuf, porjeektota hunda keessatti hojii ijaarsaa dhaabaa eegumsa qabu hojiirra oolchuuf waadaa gale.
